verdict.rationale: Delegated third-party access is a fair question for a state tax agency, but the evidence pack never documents designees, authorized tax preparers, power-of-attorney, registered agents, or representative access in My DOR. It only describes the business's own account, filing, and payment flows. The authenticated portal could not be inspected, so the absence rests on the open guidance pages alone.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
